propositions: Nested pytest collection subprocess launched by _collect_node_ids without --basetemp allows session cleanup to delete or traverse a shared numbered temp root, potentially interfering with concurrent test runs.
Supplying a caller-owned private --basetemp directory to the nested pytest collection subprocess isolates its temp state and prevents interference with other temp trees.

A regression test proves that a pre-existing sentinel file in a shared numbered temp root is deleted or corrupted when --basetemp is omitted from _collect_node_ids, but survives unchanged when private basetemp is provided.
_collect_node_ids must preserve its collection selection, stdout parsing, return-code contract (0/5), timeout (300s), and node ID parsing behavior while adding private basetemp isolation.
